unresolved.message: no configured service serves GET /v1/orders at an address read in full, though api GET /${…}v1/orders answers it if the part of its address nobody read is left open
unresolved.hint: This is not evidence that the route is missing. Part of the route’s address could not be read — a prefix or a version assembled from a setting, usually, with a row of its own where it is built — and until that part is read no request can be joined to it.

unresolved.message: no configured service serves GET /v1/orders/:param at an address read in full, though api GET /${…}v1/orders/:param answers it if the part of its address nobody read is left open
unresolved.hint: This is not evidence that the route is missing. Part of the route’s address could not be read — a prefix or a version assembled from a setting, usually, with a row of its own where it is built — and until that part is read no request can be joined to it.
Add the service that answers it to services[], or annotate the method with /** @flowatlas-calls GET /v1/invoices */.
